name: D07_7_two_creatures_entering_at_once_each_draw
notes: Printed: 'Whenever a creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, draw a card.' With Anthem of Champions ('Creatures you control get +1/+1') in play, Guarded Heir's enters trigger creates two 3/3 Knight tokens at once; with the anthem both are 4/4. Each of the two creatures is a creature with power 4 or greater entering under my control, so the Uprising triggers for each: two cards are drawn (hand 2). The Heir itself (a 1/1, 2/2 with the anthem) does not trigger it.
